prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Forest biome nature kit, 26 pieces, labels exactly as written in quotes, sizes as width x height. Row 1, TREES: "Forest pine, tall" 7 x 16 m (straight reddish-brown trunk, dense dark green clumped needle tiers to a point); "Forest pine, slim" 5 x 12 m (slimmer, sparser pine); "Birch, broad" 7 x 13 m (white trunk with black marks, light yellow-green clumped canopy); "Birch, slender" 5 x 10 m (thinner birch, narrow open canopy); "Duskcrown tree, broad" 15 x 13 m (thick twisting broadleaf trunk, wide umbrella crown of red and violet clumped leaf masses); "Duskcrown tree, young" 8 x 8 m (single leaning trunk, smaller red-to-violet crown); "Giant pine (old growth)" 14 x 18 m (massive buttressed trunk with shelf fungus, sparse layered dark green crown high up). Row 2, UNDERSTORY: "Fern clump" 1.6 x 1 m; "Bramble thicket" 2 x 1.2 m (thorny dark-green mound with red berries); "Fallen log" 5 x 1.3 m (hollow mossy pine log, splintered end, small mushrooms); "Broken stump" 1.8 x 2.2 m (jagged snapped trunk, flared roots, shelf fungus); "Mushroom cluster" 1 x 0.8 m (tan caps on a moss pad, not glowing); "Fern with fireflies" 1.4 x 1.2 m (small fern with a few warm gold glowing points). Row 3, GROUND COVER: "Needle litter" 1.2 x 0.15 m (flat rust-brown needle drift with pine cones); "Leaf litter" 1.2 x 0.15 m (flat orange-brown oak leaves); "Moss clump" 1.3 x 0.4 m; "Surface roots" 1.8 x 0.35 m (grey-brown root tangle half buried). Row 4, ROCK: "Forest boulder, large" 2 x 1.5 m (rounded dark stone, moss caps); "Forest boulder, cluster" 2 x 1.2 m (three or four smaller mossy stones); "Split rock" 1.8 x 1.8 m (upright dark stone cracked into three leaning slabs); "Slate slab" 2 x 0.6 m (low stack of flat dark plates); "Hollow outcrop" 2.4 x 2 m (ring of stacked mossy blocks around a round see-through hole). Row 5, ISLE EDGE, each drawn as its own separate piece: "Fern-hung isle edge" 8 x 4 m (needle litter, ferns and red-leaved shrubs on top, dark mossy stone face, roots and moss curtains hanging below, flat cut ends so segments tile, no log and no waterfall on it); "Fallen trunk over the edge" 7 x 1.4 m (dead mossy branching trunk lying horizontal, bare broken branches at the tip, drawn alone); "Brook waterfall" 1.6 x 8 m (a tall white-blue ribbon of falling water with foam at the top, drawn alone as a chunky solid ribbon); "Hollow underside taper" 8 x 10 m (inverted cone of dark mossy stone pierced by a round hole, roots coiling round the hole and trailing below the tip, moss curtains). Dark mossy stone and deep greens as in the attached sheet. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Forest nature kit".
